subject: Recap + scheduling: BioClinic evaluation kickoff and trial charter
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@bioclinic.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: Redwood evaluation kickoff for BioClinic

Hi Sana —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation started: 

- Primary success criteria: reduce manual triage time for incoming lab reports by 60% and surface high-confidence anomalies for clinician review.
- Scope for the trial: 2 weeks ingestion + 2 weeks validation against your 5k historical reports; live inference on a 3-node dedicated pool.
- Data notes: we'll only persist tokens for 72 hours for the trial; KMS-managed keys per your SOC requirements.
- Team & roles: your side — Sana (pm), Tom (eng); Redwood side — Alex (AM), Grace (tech lead), Marissa (CS).

Proposed slots for the evaluation kickoff + tech deep dive (PT):
- Wed, Jun 16 — 09:00–10:00 PT (30–45 min agenda + 15 min Q&A)
- Thu, Jun 17 — 13:00–14:00 PT (deeper infra/ingest ops slot)

Please confirm which slot works or propose 1–2 alternatives. Attached is a draft trial charter and a short prompt-set template we usually use to seed evals. If you can share a short sample of the report schema ahead of the kickoff, Grace can map expected transforms and ingestion shape.

Attachments: Redwood-BioClinic-Trial-Charter-v0.2.pdf (draft), prompt-set-template.csv

Looking forward —

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: Redwood evaluation kickoff for BioClinic

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the summary — that looks right to us. Quick notes and availability:

- Success criteria and scope look good; we may narrow the validation set to 2k reports for the first run if we hit data cleanup issues.
- Availability: Wed 6/16 is tricky for Tom. We can do either of these: 
  * Wed, Jun 16 — 11:00–11:45 PT
  * Thu, Jun 17 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Please include an agenda that calls out: 1) ingestion sample mapping, 2) prompt/label format, 3) success metric instrumentation. Also can you confirm the minimum infra footprint and whether we can start with a single GPU node for the first dry run?

I'll attach a short example of your report schema and loop Tom in for tech details.

Best,
Sana Patel
Product Lead — Clinical AI | BioClinic
sana.patel@bioclinic.com

1) Intros & roles (5 min)
2) Ingest sample and schema mapping (10–15 min) — Grace will walk through the expected transforms and required sample file layout.
3) Prompt set & labeling format (10 min) — Marissa will show the prompt/template we use for precision/recall baselining.

5) Action items and timeline (5–10 min)
